notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/0c58e139f257b4c5230a3b0c1f2a89e422cf0504.png

As the journey continues, you will join Hu Shanshan and the Nameless Wanderer, to unravel the secrets behind the ledger found at the Dragon Tiger Gate headquarters. This quest will take you deep into the heart of Loulan. Keep your wits about you, as you may find the journey more difficult than expected.

For the duration of this event, the following bonuses have been activated.

Maximum Life increase by 25000
Maximum Vital Energy increase by 15000
10/1000 of Damage absorbed into Life

The Blood of Iron: Chapter 7 Buff will last for 180 minutes. When the buff expires, you can relog in Hefei to receive the buff again.

notes.title: Blood of Iron: Chapter 6
notes.content:
[code][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/55b9622e3af0895a63d4c88f508274ca4c5e8ed3.png"]

After going dark for quite some time, Hu Shanshan finally returns from her mission. Having decrypted the cipher that was obtained from the Black Dragons Clan, she has sent out an urgent message. It seems the Black Dragon's reach has extended further than anticipated. In this chapter of the Blood of Iron Saga, Hu Shanshan is seeking your aid to help unravel the schemes of the Black Dragon Clan, before it's too late.

Blood of Iron - Chapter 6: Commemorative Gift
In Commemoration of the Blood of Iron Chapter 6 you will be able to obtain the following items via the Event Window (H-Key).

1x (New) 9Dragons Premium (30 Days)
3x Warehouse Expansion (30 Days)
1x [2025] Growth Support Box


Blood of Iron: Chapter 6 Buff
For the duration of this event, the following bonuses have been activated.

Maximum Life increase by 25000
Maximum Vital Energy increase by 15000
10/1000 of Damage absorbed into Life
10/1000 of Damage absorbed into Vital Energy
Increases Exp gain by 20%

The Blood of Iron: Chapter 6 Buff will last for 180 minutes. When the buff expires, you can relog in Hefei to receive the buff again.

Blood of Iron: Chapter 6 Event Quests
Upon decrypting the cipher, Hu Shanshan unveils that a Black Dragons Clan spy within the League of Beggars Clan, and most likely the other clans as well. Assist Hu Shanshan by identifying the spy within your own clan and follow their trail of corruption to its source. In this chapter, each clan will have their own questline, including Vagabonds.

notes.title: Kowloon Memorial
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/be1e24f86b2b5d57ced30a4d213ef4f61d54bde3.png

A Memorial is being held in Hefei to honor the souls of those who lost their lives in the War of the Nine Dragons. Warriors of all clans are welcome to pay their respects. As there was once a great turmoil between the black and the white clans, one can only hope a gathering such as this would be a peaceful one. In this event, you will have a chance to obtain new exclusive event items, and valuable in-game materials.

Welcome Gift for New Heroes
For the duration of this event, you will be able to obtain the following items via the Event Window (H-Key).

Heaven's Guard Weapon Exchange ticket
Heaven's Guard Spirit Exchange Ticket
National Hero Badge


Kowloon Memorial Ceremony Buff
In honor of those who lost their lives, the following buffs have been activated.

Maximum Life increase by 25000
Maximum Vital Energy increase by 15000
10/1000 of Damage absorbed into Life
10/1000 of Damage absorbed into Vital Energy
Increases Exp gain by 20%

The Kowloon Memorial Ceremony Buff will last for 180 minutes. When the buff expires, you can relog in Hefei to receive the buff again.

notes.title: Radiant Temple
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/b7bf2fd363b6ca1f66d222f80b076e5d66239879.png

An anonymous letter arrives, in regards to strange occurrences happening since the arrival of the Radiant Temple, located in the village of Hwangwang. As a place that has been known to have found peace through the teachings of Buddha, claims about the village calls for a thorough investigation. In this event, you will uncover the mysteries of the Radiant Temple and the people of Hwangwang village for a chance to obtain exclusive Relics, Ornaments, and Costumes.

Temple of Radiant Light Buff
Basked in the aura of the Radiant Temple, the following buffs have been activated.

Maximum Life increase by 25000
Maximum Vital Energy increase by 15000
10/1000 of Damage absorbed into Life
10/1000 of Damage absorbed into Vital Energy
Increases Exp gain by 20%

The Temple of Radiant Life Buff will last for 180 minutes. When the buff expires, you can relog in Hefei to receive the buff again.

Radiant Temple Event Quests
Since the appearance of the Radiant Temple, villagers who grew suspicious of it, have been disappearing one by one, without a trace. It is up to you to heed the pleas of a mysterious letter and investigate the seemingly peaceful village of Hwangwang

notes.content:

What would have been a copious harvest for Herb Village, quickly turned into misfortune after a neglectful villager ate food from the offering table meant to appease the spirits who once tended to the lands. But is that all there is to it? Come to the aid of the Herb Village, solve the mystery of the Hidden Valley, and save the Thanksgiving bounty from ruin!

Maximum Life increase by 25000
Maximum Vital Energy increase by 15000

notes.title: Ghost Festival
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/b92ad3d424b0d74f2fbed2eb5466e55cef15c2be.png
Every year in Qingdao, a festival is held to honor the spirits of the dead. People from all across The Land show up dressed in costumes of ghouls and ghosts to imbibe and dance until the sun comes up. This year, there have been reports of residents disappearing, and our heroes have been called forth to investigate this occurrence. Uncover the mystery and you will be rewarded greatly, however, you might be in for more than you bargained for.

Ghost Festival Buff
In celebration of the spirits of the dead, the following buffs have been activated.

Maximum Life increase by 25000
Maximum Vital Energy increase by 15000

Increases Exp Gain by 20%

The Ghost Festival Buff will last for 180 minutes. When the buff expires, you can relog to receive the buff again.

In the war between Kunlun Immortal Sages and the Blood Sorcerers, a secret plan to perform a ritual to seize the power of a long forgotten deity has been unveiled. While the threat of using the corrupted god's energy to achieve immense destructive power looms over the land, Kunlun's Sages have called out to any brave warrior willing to face it.  Answer the call and you will be in the favor of the Kunlun Sages.

Altar of the Forgotten God Buff

Maximum Life increase by 25000

An ominous fog has swept across The Land, bringing with it a ghastly ship and a crew of undead pirates. Although their intentions are unclear, one thing for certain is that they leave nothing but chaos and destruction in their wake. Heroes have been called from the farthest reaches in order to eliminate the threat where others could not. Defeat them and you may just uncover the riches they have plundered over the centuries.

Ghost Ship of the Abyss Buff

Maximum Life increases by 25000
Maximum Vital Energy increases by 15000
10/1000 of Damage absorbed into Life
10/1000 of Damage absorbed into Vital Energy
Increases EXP gain by 20%

The Ghost Ship of the Abyss buff will last for 180 minutes. When the buff expires you can relog to receive the buff again.

During the duration of the event, [event] Blue Will-o-Wisp, and [event] Red Will-o-Wisp will be spawned throughout Liaodong. The [event] Blue Will-o-Wisp can transform into a Goblin Spirit, and [event] Red Will-o-Wisp can turn into a Jiangshi Spirit.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/64a34618b763ff1f2c10ff0d810fd131bb9ceb94.jpg

Ancient ancestral ruins have been unearthed in the depths of Kunlun. The mystery and wonder of this sacred site is not without its perils extending across The Land. Investigate these ruins and the disaster it spreads, for a chance to obtain great fortune and fame!

Ancient Ruins Buff
With the opening of the Ancient Ruins Chambers an aura was released across The Land, granting the following bonuses.

Maximum Life increases by 25000
Maximum Vital Energy increases by 15000
10/1000 of Damage Absorbed into Life
10/1000 of Damage absorbed into Vital Energy
Increases Exp gain by 20%

The Ancient Ruins Buff will last for 180 minutes. When the buff expires, you can relog to receive the buff again.

Ancient Ruins Event Quest
According to the rumors of one nameless wanderer, Ancient Ruins have been discovered in the pit of Loulan. Rumor has it that none who have dared to enter have returned. Will you claim the fortune that awaits or become another statistic?

Road to Karma Quest: [event] Ancient Ruins (Daily)
NPC: N/A
Condition: Accept windgram
Reward: Nameless Wanderer's Request Tablet (3)

Kunlun's Filial Son Event Quest
Due to the excavation of the Ancient Ruins, a rock slide has occurred in Kunlun, causing Hwang-Sik to be halted from returning home to his mother. There is a detour, but perilous white tigers infest the path. Help this loyal citizen return to his mother.

Road to Karma Quest: Hunting White Tiger from Kunlun Mountain (Daily)
NPC: Festival Trainee Baekhwa (Hefei)
Condition: Accept Quest
Reward: Hwang-Sik's Request Letter (3)

Ancient Ruins and Kunlun Mountain Event Dungeons
Should you decide to brave the ancient ruins of Loulan you will be met with great peril, for if you get past the raiders who seek to claim its riches, you will then have to face the guardians that protect its sacred grounds. If you can come back alive, you will surely reap the fame and fortune of your discoveries.

notes.title: Blood of Iron: Chapter 2
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/80992669ef452d6e548ca11a35a860a1653c29b6.png

In this second installment of the Blood of Iron saga, we rejoin Gong Jiamu and Yiqian Li in their journey through the North Sea. Unravel the mysteries of their quest to the North Sea and the secrets behind the Icy Palace. While under the constant pursuit of the Black Dragons Clan, the task is fraught with peril. But with great risks comes even greater rewards.

Blood of Iron Buff
Continue your journey into the North Sea with the Blood of Iron buff. The following bonuses will run for the event period's duration.

Maximum Life/Vital Energy increase by 10000
10/1000 of Damage absorbed into Life
10/1000 of Damage absorbed into Vital Energy
Increases Exp gain by 20%

The Blood of Iron Buff lasts for 180 minutes. Once it expires, you can relog to receive it again.


Blood of Iron: Chapter 2 Questline
Upon finishing the Blood of Iron: Chapter 1 quest line, Wan Daye will contact you to meet with Gong Jiamu and Yiqian Li after their arrival in the North Sea. Following their lead, with the aid of the North Sea citizens, it is your task to investigate the newly controlled Icy Palace, and the secrets hidden behind its well fortified walls. Through this journey, you will find that violence is not always the answer, and sometimes you could use a helping hand in a dire situation.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/be305bc6fa56d47e3cd06b26ea48689e916a6ceb.jpg

Upon completing this quest line, you will be rewarded with a Peerless Under Heaven (30 Days) Epithet Scroll for your efforts.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/f8a5ef89d19f1921ba9fd8af5971c425fdc4e599.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/3c8ae45a1482383054fff34e802db791079f10b1.jpg

With the passes obtained from the weekly quest, you will be able to enter the true version of the Icy Palace Secret Passage Dungeon. Upon completion of this dungeon, you will receive relics, consumables, and valuable materials, some of which can be used to create event items, that are only available for a limited time.

notes.title: Mysterious Island
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/9863b138455fbf82f089e55bfdc46d81a1a5c1a6.png

Off of the southern region of Liaodong, a Mysterious island has been unveiled. Undisturbed for over a millennia, this island is riddled with the power of the Four Shenshou, aka the Four Guardian Deities. Drawn by this divine power, the evil known as Fu-Nanchoo has extended his hand to corrupt the Shenshou to do his bidding. Rid this land of his grasp and purify the guardians, and you just might claim their power as your own in the process. In this event, you can participate in event dungeons and quests for a chance to create some powerful relics, ornaments, and costumes imbued with the energy of the four guardian deities.

Summer Buff
Embrace the power of the sun with the Summer Buff. The following bonuses will run for the event period's duration.

All Resistance increases by 999
Critical Defense increases by 700%

The Summer Buff lasts for 180 minutes. Once it expires, you can relog to receive it again.

Mysterious Island Event Quests
Suffering the wrath of the corrupted Shenshou, it is of great urgency to purify the island and bring peace to all the land. As such, quests have been put out to do just that. See Festival Trainees Baekhwa and Jeoksam in Hefei to accept these quests.

Heroic Quest (Daily): To the Mysterious Island
NPC: Festival Trainee Baekhwa (Hefei)
Condition: Lv 150+
Reward: Smuggler Secret Ticket (3)

Heroic Quest (Daily): The Wherabouts of the Corrupted Four Guardians
NPC: Festival Trainee Jeoksam (Hefei)
Condition: Lv 150+ Kill [Corruption Shenshou] Blue Dragon
Reward: Proof of Corrupted Defeated Shenshou

Mysterious Island Dungeon

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/fb6b6ac636542481a4fda5e463c19d10dcf235a1.png

Follow Fu-Nanchoo's trail of corruption to the source of the Four Guardian's power in the Mysterious Island Dungeon. In order to purify the island, you will not only need to rid it of Fu-Nanchoo's grasp, but also defeat the corrupted Shenshou to bring them back to their senses as guardians. To reach this island, you will need to take a smuggler's boat docked by the Shool of Rising Sun in Liadong. It will cost 3x Smuggler Secret Tickets to enter the dungeon which can be obtained via Baekhwa's event quest, or by resourcing [event] Smuggler's Secret Box through The NPC Seo Hwarang.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/3fd25636b95e4ce5411612251007ebb2b164abeb.png

The Mysterious Island Dungeon entrance can be found in Liaodong at coordinates 495,190.

notes.title: Clan Dungeon 2nd Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/577c9b0fae32745a39837055ad3ecbc58125db56.png

As the Black Dragons Clan rises in power, they extend their control deeper into the land. The Shaolin and Sacred Flower clans, originally thought to be impenetrable, have been compromised. As this threat extends beyond individual clans, a temporary alliance has been made, to make all clan dungeons available to any willing to take on the Black Dragons. In this update, we are introducing two new raid format dungeons for both the Shaolin and Sacred Flower, you can participate in to obtain materials to create a new set of powerful relics, in addition to the armor sets and clan skills already available.

Access the dungeon solo or party with four players to defeat fearsome monsters and obtain top-tier equipment.


Level Requirement: 230+
Solo or four players parties can enter the dungeon.
You can choose between Normal and Hard (True) dungeons.
Each dungeon can be entered once per day, for a total of 4 entries. (Solo: Normal/True, Party: Normal/True)
Create New Equipment.


New Clan Dungeon Entrances
To ensure that every clan dungeon can be accessed by any clan, the dungeon entrances have been move to the Highlands of Bamboo Village.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/83533765cbf023e26d7503dd41733112066e752e.png

Wu-Tang Dungeon
Enter the Wu-Tang Dungeon by clicking the Blue Statue. Enter the True Wu-Tang Dungeon by clicking the Red Statue.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/b82fcd0a1857e3ce28db3316ecbefc825c4e8f37.png

Defeat all deviants, including one Sub-Boss and one Final Boss. The door leading into the Final Boss stage will not open until all deviants are defeated.

Heavenly Demon Dungeon

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/c6b9fcd59fabc8531b83966844a39461cc0b17bf.png

Shaolin Dungeon
Enter the Shaolin Dungeon by clicking the Blue Statue. Enter the True Shaolin Dungeon by clicking the Red Statue

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/0149fbc650d2586bb3a0a47d557f583f1e530f90.png

Defeat all deviant waves, including one Sub-Boss and one Final Boss. The final boss will have 2 forms.

Sacred Flower Dungeon
Enter the Sacred Flower Dungeon by clicking the Blue Statue. Enter the True Sacred Flower Dungeon by clicking.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/7d95ecea76292a3bc47be5acdf5d426ff21e27a9.png

Defeat all deviant waves, including one Sub-Boss and one Final Boss. The final boss will have 2 forms.

Rewards
You can receive additional contribution rewards when you party up with 4 players. The type of rewards is differentiated between Normal and True difficulty. Rewards will be distributed according to who has dealt the most damage to the boss monster. (Same system as East & West Temple.) For a limited time, True difficulty dungeons will give 1 extra Clan Additional Reward Box for both Solo and Party Dungeons.

The reward UI can be accessed by clicking the green gift box on the right-hand side of your screen.

notes.title: Event: Training for a Hot Summer
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/d9175a4d4e2479343a39f975a542f18a0c7ba847.jpg

Summer is on its way, but your summer bod has yet to arrive! We have just the event to whip you into shape! Storyteller Kong Son Myeong has a training regimen, designed to increase your vital energy, where you can earn powerful relics by completing quests. And if you're looking to test your newfound strength, The Three Princesses is seeking revenge on the Iwami Clan for bitter childhood memories. Of course, you will be well rewarded for your efforts. While you're there, you might as well take advantage of the clamming season in Hainan! Log in and make those summer gains!

Training for a Hot Summer Event Quests

Kong Son-Myeong
Looking to improve the potency and stamina of your Vital Energy? The storyteller in Hefei knows just the tasks to help you improve in this area of your martial arts, which can only be achieved during the heat of summer! Complete these tasks and earn yourself some powerful relics. Don't wait for time to pass you by!

Road to Karma: [event] Ways to Overcome Summer 1
NPC: Storyteller, Kong Son-Myeong (Hefei)
Condition: Level 157+ and kill [infinite] Guardian Beast (Infinite Dungeon 10th Floor)
Reward: Small Blue Moon Flower

Road to Karma: [event] Ways to Overcome Summer 2
NPC: Storyteller, Kong Son-Myeong (Hefei)
Condition: Level 157+ and kill Golden Touch of Golden Castle (Golden Castle Red Pass)
Reward: Blooming Blue Moonflower

Road to Karma: [event] Ways to Overcome Summer 3
NPC: Storyteller, Kong Son-Myeong (Hefei)
Condition: Level 157+ and kill (Extreme) North Sea Queen (Icy Palace Dungeon Red Pass)
Reward: Frozen Blue Moonflower

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/4e228bff2d463a47b9d461d66f31b1c99245a827.jpg

Summer is coming, and that means fantastic weather, and even greater events to participate in while you escape the heat! Take on legendary creatures and forgotten recluse masters for a chance to make new Relics, Costumes, and Guardians that will keep you ahead of the fire. Log in today to see what's hot!

Plain Wind Buff
Despite the blazing heat, a refreshing breeze comes in the form of the Plain Wind Buff. The following bonuses will run for the event period's duration.

Maximum Life increases by 10000
Maximum Vital Energy increases by 10000

The Plain Wind Buff will last for 180 minutes. When the buff expires, you can relog to receive the buff again.


Three Legged Blood Spirit
The air in Hefei has been set ablaze with unbearable heat, reducing the once bustling marketplace into a ghost town. The culprit is none other than the legendary Three Legged Blood Spirit, known to bring intense heat wherever it appears. The only way to quell this insatiable weather is to face the beast head on.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/d79b58d5da45d14799bf883b362cd92ba2c213e9.jpg

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/45dc267cf6cd8c415518b25875c0bba0caec5696.png

The infamous mad cult scientist Fu-Nanchoo is a killer on the loose, aiming for world domination. Rumor has it that his experiments involve creating clones of evil deviants, and even himself, to aid him in his evil plights. It is up to you to stop this criminal mastermind in his tracks! Bring him to justice and you may be able to obtain some of the items that helped him rise to power!

This event will run simultaneously with the Spring is Coming Event.

Virtuous Aura Buff
In the face of true danger, a virtuous aura fills the air. The following bonuses will run for the event duration.

Maximum Life increases by 5000
Maximum Vital Energy increases by 15000
Movement Speed increases by 20%

The Virtuous Aura Buff will last for 180 minutes. When the buff expires, you can relog to receive the buff again.

The Many Faces of Fu-Nanchoo
Fu-Nanchoo is on the loose and has his sights set on ruling all of The Land. He as been seen in several places at the same time, so it is questionable which one is the real Fu-NanChoo, if any of them at all. Recently he has been seen in Bamboo Village, Bloody Plain, and Liaodong.

notes.title: Spring is Coming
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/87de292dc781c8ae0e2cb99bc43746d5bc3ba643.png

With the coming of spring, warmth fills the air and the smell of flowers blooming saturate the land. To celebrate the spring solstice, we have prepared some great events you can participate in to create powerful Accessories, Relics, and Potions that are sure to help turn the tide of battle. Log in to see what this spring event has to offer!

Spring Buff
With the warm wind of spring comes the blessings of the Spring Buff. The following bonuses, will run for the event period's duration.

Body Damage increases by 500
Maximum Life increases by 10000
Maximum Vital Energy increases by 10000

The Spring Buff will last for 180 minutes. When the buff expires, you can relog to receive the buff again.

Playtime Bonus
Each day you log in, make sure to click your “Stamp Tracker” icon located below the mini-map in the game to receive your reward(s). During the event duration you can receive one Cherry Blossom Buds by logging in for one hour through Daily Playtime Bonus, and an [Event] Cherry Blossom Buds Box by logging in for 110 hours through Monthly Playtime Bonus.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/8f3d602d6d54c0a676547131b7e7badee8dbab03.png


Click the “Stamp Tracker” icon below the game's mini-map to display the Accumulated Event.
You must achieve a cumulative amount of minutes/hours over the event period logged in to receive the event prizes.
The prizes are cumulative. If you qualified for a higher tier of Playtime rewards, you would receive all lower tiers.

[Event] Cherry Blossom Buds Box Contains the following items.

Cherry Blossom Buds (60)
Gold Traditional Pattern Piece (3)


Spring Event Dungeons

There is a new strange power that looms over the land in the form of great crystals, linking distant lands through a series of portals that can only be entered using ancient Red and Gold Traditional Pattern Pieces. Fortunately, one of those portals has presented itself in Bamboo Village.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/c213484d0dc214fdd500e2252d785a8e9de92f49.jpg

The Great Crystal Dungeons can be entered at coordinates (126, 140) in the area circled in the map below.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/38f347fbbe5f870e841da5df38de649b52a15607.png

Great Crystal Dungeon (Normal)
Enter the portal to the normal dungeon and defeat the deviants which control the area. This dungeon can be entered using 3x Red Traditional Pattern Pieces.

Great Crystal Dungeon (Normal) Drops

Bead of Storm
Bead of Storm (Gold)
Full Moon Epic Scroll (10 Days)
Red Moon Epic Stroll 10 Days
Taoist Water Herb

Great Crystal Dungeon (Hard)
Enter the portal to the hard dungeon which will lead you directly to the great crystals where you can put an end to the threat brought upon the land. Keep in mind that the closer you get to the source of its power, the stronger the deviants you will run into. This dungeon can be entered using 3x Gold Traditional Pattern Pieces.

notes.content:

Come one, come all! The time has come to celebrate 9Dragons Awaken's 7th Anniversary! We are more than thankful for those who have joined us on this journey thus far, and are excited to share the road ahead! To show our appreciation, We have put together an assortment of events you can participate in to join in the festivities!

7th Anniversary Gift
Spark off the celebration and claim 3x 7th Anniversary Silver Dragon Coins simply by logging into game! You can claim this gift by clicking on the gift box icon or pressing the (H) key. Use these items to participate in daily event quests, and/or trade them in for valuable items from the Festival Merchant NPC's. (The 7th Anniversary Gift can be claimed once per account during the event duration)

7th Anniversary Buff
In celebration of our 7th anniversary, we're activating the following bonuses, which will run for the event period's duration.

Soul Damage increases by 777
All Resistance increased by 777
Maximum Life increases by 17777
Maximum Vital Energy increases by 17777

The 7th Anniversary Event Buff will last for 180 minutes. When the buff expires, you can relog to receive the buff again.

Hello Dragons!

It's time for the most mouthwatering contest of the year! One thing all cultures have in common is a love for sweets and desserts, and we want to see your favorites! Post a picture of your most sought after desserts for a chance to win some irresistible prizes!

Write your "Character Name", "Sweet Tooth Nom Nom 2022" and "playredfox.com/ninedragons" on a piece of paper.

5 Winners: 2,000 RC + Splendor Branch (10)

Rules and Restrictions:

The contest entry period begins on December 8, 2022, and ends on December 29, 2022. Winners will be announced on January 5, 2023.
The reward distribution time is tentative and subject to change.
Participants must submit their entries by replying to this official contest thread.
Prizes will be granted to the posting account and are non-transferable to a different account.
Entries cannot contain any copyrighted material except the material copyrighted by RedFox Games & Nine Dragons Awaken.
Entries cannot contain any material that violates the Forum Code of Conduct or Terms of Service.
Winners will be determined by the subjective judgment of the 9Dragons team.
Using multiple accounts to submit additional entries on the 9Dragons forums is prohibited. Anyone found using multiple accounts will be disqualified.

Be sure to get your entries in by December 29, 2022, in order to qualify! We look forward to seeing all of your wonderful holiday dishes!

notes.title: Contest: Halloween Carving 2022
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/b1cb82af261faf7b62db8c6d8e5bb68801984fe9.png

As clouds loom over the Autumn sky, only the light from the jack-o' lanterns shines through the darkness of the land. Use your imagination and creative abilities, and submit a photo of your best jack-o-lantern carving for the chance to win some hauntingly amazing prizes that will get you out of your britches!

Submission Date: October 27, 2022 - November 21, 2022
Winners Announcement: November 24, 2022

How to Enter

Carve your choice of pumpkin, squash, fruits, or melon.
Snap a photo with a hand-written postcard displaying your character name, Halloween Carving 2022, and www.playredfox.com/nine_dragons.

Example:

[gm]Ahri
Halloween Carving 2022
www.playredfox.com/nine_dragons


Then click the UPLOAD A FILE button below to submit your entry.


Submission Tips:

Try to take the best picture possible, as picture quality helps make a good impression on the judges.
Get the lighting right. Some jack-o-lanterns will look best lit up at night. Others call for a dramatically cloudy daytime sky or even full sunshine. Experiment to see what looks best for you.
Pay close attention to the background of your carving.
You can have a look at past winners here.


Prizes

1st (1 Winner) - 10,000 RedFox Credits
2nd (1 Winners) - 7,500 RedFox Credits
3rd (1 Winners) - 5,000 RedFox Credits
4th (2 Winners) - 2,500 RedFox Credits
5 Lucky Winners will randomly receive 1,000 RedFox Credits

Winners selection is based on submission and is subject to change. 

Rules & Restrictions

Participants must submit their entries by replying to this official Contest thread. 
Participants can enter as many different pumpkins as they'd like per account.
Entries that do not meet these requirements will be disqualified.
Prizes will be granted to the posting account and non-transferable to a different account.
Entries cannot contain any material that violates the Forum Code of Conduct or Terms of Service.
Winners will be determined by the subjective judgment of the 9Dragons team.
Keep the thread clean; off-topic will be deleted.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/e30b5ffa56f7764a826f1cb7d1f74fb024b82313.png

There are so many reasons to love the Fall. You get Halloween, for one, a time to be spooky, and Thanksgiving, a time of sharing and being thankful for everything we have. To celebrate them both, we have a cornucopia of eerily fantastic events to brighten up the fall mood! Enjoy event quests, buffs, dungeons, and Hero Tournaments, for a chance to obtain exclusive costumes, bags, and relics and earn some highly sought-after materials. Don't miss your chance and log in today!

Fall Festival Buff
Celebrate the change in season from Summer to Fall with the following bonuses.

Maximum Life Increases by 30000
Attack Speed increases by 20%

The Fall Festival Buff will last for 180 minutes. When the buff expires, you can relog to receive the buff again.

Thanksgiving Gift
Once per account during the event, you can receive a free [event] Thanksgiving Present Box! To receive this item, click on the gift icon on the right of your game window, or press the H key to pull up the Event Window.

notes.title: Server Maintenance: 10/25/22 | Patch 323
notes.content:
Dear Nine Dragons Community,

The servers will undergo maintenance and server update on October 25, 2022, at 18:30 server time. The downtime will be approximately 3 hours.

Changes and Updates:

Routine server checks.
Moonlight event will end.
Fall Festival event will begin. You can find full event details here.
Kunlun Accessories [6-10s] (set) has been added to the Resource list of the Master Geisha, Chulmok in Qingdao. You can find full details here.
Marketplace: Hwarin's Signature Costume Bundle Box content has been updated. You can find full details here.
Holist's skill description has been modified for transparency. Entelechy Art of Heaven and Earth (League of Beggars), Summoning Spirits of Fire Ghost (Sacred Flower), Diamond Art of Power (Shaolin), Demon Healing of Blood The Sky (Heavenly Demon), and Armored Art of Power (Brotherhood) are PvP exclusive skills.
Fixed an issue where non-cancelable quests can now be canceled.
Fixed an issue where the remaining daily dungeon entries count displayed incorrectly.
Fix an error where the quick slot displays costume, weapon, armor, and relic icon.
Fix an error where bosses are trapped behind Loulan Golden Castle's walls.
Fix an error where monsters sometimes don't appear correctly in Infinite Dungeon.
Various text localization has been addressed.
Hero Band and Master & Disciple applicant lists will be reset.
Infinite Dungeon ranking will be reset, and points will be distributed to the top 50.


Thank you for your patience during the maintenance.

Giant ravenous roosters are rampaging Qingdao's main street, and it's up to you to slay them! The Entrance to the Main Street Dungeon can be found near Ghiryu Tower at coordinates (250,305). You will need the [event] Purple Stone of Qingdao to enter this dungeon. [event] Purple Stones can either be dropped from the Backstreet Dungeon or obtained through the [event]Moonlight Box.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/6dbf348b860c9f820a6ad6b3284edba82f62626a.png

This dungeon is a wave format dungeon in which you will need to defeat Big and Shiny Roosters before they disappear. The Big and Shiny Roosters will be hard if not impossible to kill alone, so join in a party of up to 8 people. Killing Next Stage Hens will drop items, as well as summon the next wave of Big Roosters. Shiny Roosters will be summoned at the 3rd Stage.


The Event Rooster, in the north of Qingdao, is there to provide the basic rules of the event dungeon.
Due to the moon's brightness, Roosters are very resilient and have a higher resistance to Yin.
Add any combination of Yin, Yang, Body, and Soul Damage to increase your ability to defeat the Roosters.
Drop Rate increases of any kind are recommended for getting the most out of the Main Street Dungeon drops.
Roosters can get exhausted, so beat them before they disappear; otherwise, you will not get any rewards.
Defeating the Roosters alone is impossible, so be sure to party up with other members!
Roosters are immune to CC. Stun and Area skills are not applied.
Once a Shiny Rooster is defeated, the dungeon will be completed, so in order to kill both of them, they should be killed at the same time.
As some players may have difficulty finding a large party to play with, players will be able to obtain items from the Next Stage Hens.

 Routine server checks.

notes.title: Server Maintenance: 5/10/22 | Patch 299
notes.content:
Dear Nine Dragons Community,

The servers will undergo maintenance and server update on May 10, 2022, at 18:30 server time. The downtime will be approximately 3-5 hours.

Changes and Updates:

Routine server checks.
Spring event will end.
White Dragon Treasure event will begin. You can find full event details here.
White Dragon Treasure Box item content renewal. NEW: Receive 1 Key of White Dragon Treasure Box with each box opened. Collect 10 keys to exchange for 1 White Dragon Treasure Box.
Restoration Tool is now available to purchase at the Ancient Secret Restorer, Keumbi Ho.
Improved the stats of Infinite Dark Soul and Infinite Vaisravana Costumes.

Infinite Dark Soul Costume: Weapon Damage: 25% → 75%, All Resistances: 500 → 750, Challenge Points Gains: 5% → 10%, Max. Life: 15000 → 20000.
Infinite Vaisravana Costume: Weapon Damage: 50% → 150%, All Resistances: 1000 → 1500, Challenge Points Gains: 10% → 20%.

Improved the layout of the Character Window (C).
Double-clicking feature has been added to the Costume Gallery and Guardian (F11), where you can now double-click on the desired costume/guardian instead of clicking on the "Change" or "Summon" button.
Fixed an issue where the gate to the final boss would not open after killing all mobs and sub-bosses in True Wu-Tang Dungeon party mode.
Fixed an issue where an error occurs when trying to sell an item to the NPC with odd quantity numbers between 215 and 255.
Fixed an issue where the surrender league for Hero War can still attack the opposing victorious league.
Fixed an issue where players could attempt to send gameplay-related network event protocols without entering the field map.
Fixed an issue where the experience progress bar displayed 100% even though it did not fully meet the amount of experience required for the next level.
Fixed an issue where certain equipment options text overflowing outside the item window UI tooltip.
An issue where there is no Exit/Cancel button when entering Wu-Tang/Yanmo dungeon with not enough members has been fixed. (refer to Patch 294-296)
Fixed an issue where Chi Kung's defense stats calculation did not work correctly. (Monster's defense was set as a percentage value in DB, resulting in a constant value, which causes an issue where the damage inflicted by the character is much greater than intended.)
Modified the text of Weapon Attack → Weapon Dmg and Resistance →CC Resistance in Character Window (C).
Modified the formatting of the Victorious Energy Buff that you get from BvW War.
Hero Band and Master & Disciple applicant lists will be reset.
Infinite Dungeon ranking will be reset, and points will be distributed to the top 50.


Thank you for your patience during the maintenance.

In this update, we are introducing two new raid format dungeons, in both Wu-Tang and Mount Yanmo, in which you can obtain materials to create all-new armor sets and a brand new set of skills for all roles.

Access the dungeon solo or party with four players to defeat fearsome monsters and obtain top-tier equipment.

notes.title: Update: Infinite Dungeon Renewal
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/64449698fb8bd97fd44a6559ab7caf99d713efa6.png

After the long wait, we are happy to release the renewal of the Infinite Dungeon! Get ready to wave goodbye to the Infinite Dungeon you once knew. With all-new challenging stages, reward features, and an updated point system, this update is sure to bring you great power and fortune. Did we mention there are new items, costumes, weapons, AND relics?

About Infinite Dungeon

The Infinite Dungeon is accessible to character level Revolving Chakra 1 (37) and above. You can access the dungeon interface by clicking the Infinite Dungeon Tab after pressing the F11 key.
You will gain a certain amount of Challenge Points by clearing each stage while in the dungeon, and higher stages will payout more Challenge Points.
Points earned can be used to buy various items from Infinite Master, Man Sangja.
The number of daily entries to the Infinite Dungeon will be initialized at 00:00 server time, and the ranking will be calculated according to the stage and progress time.
Additional point rewards will be given according to the ranking calculation at the last/first maintenance each month.


Stages and Difficulty Re-Adjustment  

Stages and Difficulty Re-Adjustment
The number of stages is reduced from 50 Stages to 33 Stages, including 3 Reward Stages. The difficulty of stage 21 is similar to the existing stage 50, and starting at stage 23, it will be more difficult drastically.
3 new bosses will spawn at stage 10, stage 21, and stage 32. The type of boss will appear randomly and have powerful skills.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/10f88e0d3c87f0b03d8270d87a3b8e87f086443e.jpg

5 Entries (default) + 5 Entries (Infinite Stone) (10 Total) to 2 Entries (default) + 2 Entries (Infinite Stone) (4 Total).
Infinite Stone (30 RC) to Infinite Stone (60 RC).


Be confident in your strength and rush in without the support of a party!
Previously there were 2 modes to enter the Infinite Dungeon Solo and in a Party. However, the Infinite dungeon is now only open to Solo entries. Parties are not welcomed!

Ranking Point Distribution
Stage Clear points and ranking reward points are adjusted depending on the newly designed number of stages and difficulty level. Each month, individuals on all servers Rank 1~50 will receive the following Challenge Point Rewards.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/5a6e24523de33cbc3d2e491f598d5adee7be5769.png

Infinite Dungeon Ranking will be reset each month during maintenance. Ranking Points will be distributed prior to reset periods.

notes.title: Update: Infinite Dungeon Renewal
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/64449698fb8bd97fd44a6559ab7caf99d713efa6.png

After the long wait, we are happy to release the renewal of the Infinite Dungeon! Get ready to wave goodbye to the Infinite Dungeon you once knew. With all-new challenging stages, reward features, and an updated point system, this update is sure to bring you great power and fortune. Did we mention there are new items, costumes, weapons, AND relics?

About Infinite Dungeon

The Infinite Dungeon is accessible to character level Revolving Chakra 1 (37) and above. You can access the dungeon interface by clicking the Infinite Dungeon Tab after pressing the F11 key.
You will gain a certain amount of Challenge Points by clearing each stage while in the dungeon, and higher stages will payout more Challenge Points.
Points earned can be used to buy various items from Infinite Master, Man Sangja.
The number of daily entries to the Infinite Dungeon will be initialized at 00:00 server time, and the ranking will be calculated according to the stage and progress time.
Additional point rewards will be given according to the ranking calculation at the last/first maintenance each month.


Stages and Difficulty Re-Adjustment  

Stages and Difficulty Re-Adjustment  
The number of stages is reduced from 50 Stages to 33 Stages, including 3 Reward Stages. The difficulty of stage 21 is similar to the existing stage 50, and starting at stage 23, it will be more difficult drastically.
3 new bosses will spawn at stage 10, stage 21, and stage 32. The type of boss will appear randomly and have powerful skills.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/aec4a83abb47255e507606cc3b8451c2cfc0fe7e.png

Infinite Entry and Infinite Stone Price Adjustment

5 Entries (default) + 5 Entries (Infinite Stone) (10 Total) to 2 Entries (default) + 2 Entries (Infinite Stone) (4 Total).
Infinite Stone (30 RC) to Infinite Stone (60 RC).


Be confident in your strength and rush in without the support of a party!
Previously there were 2 modes to enter the Infinite Dungeon Solo and in a Party. However, the Infinite dungeon is now only open to Solo entries. Parties are not welcomed!


Ranking Point Distribution
Stage Clear points and ranking reward points are adjusted depending on the newly designed number of stages and difficulty level. Each month, individuals on all servers Rank 1~50 will receive the following Challenge Point Rewards.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/5a6e24523de33cbc3d2e491f598d5adee7be5769.png

Infinite Dungeon Ranking will be reset each month during maintenance. Ranking Points will be distributed prior to reset periods.

As the air chills and the nights grow darker, comes the time for jack-o-lanterns to bring their dim light throughout the land, and with them, our Halloween Carving Contest! Using your imagination and creative abilities, you can submit a photo of your best jack-o-lantern carving for the chance to win some frighteningly amazing prizes that you are sure to die for.

Submission Date: October 8, 2021 - October 30, 2021
Winners Announcement: November 5, 2021

How to Enter

Carve your choice of pumpkin, squash, fruits, or melon.
Snap a photo with a hand-written postcard displaying your character name and www.playredfox.com/nine_dragons.


Example:

[gm]Ahri
www.playredfox.com/nine_dragons

Then click the UPLOAD A FILE button below to submit your entry.

Submission Tips:

Try to take the best picture possible, as picture quality helps make a good impression on the judges.
Get the lighting right. Some jack-o-lanterns will look best lit up at night. Others call for a dramatically cloudy daytime sky or even full sunshine. Experiment to see what looks best for you.
Pay close attention to the background of your carving.
You can have a look at past winners here.

2nd (2 Winners) - 5,000 RedFox Credits

Participants must submit their entry by replying to this official Contest thread.

Winners will be determined by the subjective judgment of the 9Dragons team.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/6cbb725c93d1c2b99b6efd5e209bdc5fec63d4a1.png

As the Summer starts to heat up, it's time to show off your hottest outfits to see who's the sexiest in all the land. How to Enter

Log into Nine Dragons.
Put a Summer themed costume on your character.
Find the best summer-themed environment in the game.

Capture a screenshot by pressing Prt Sc.
Post your screenshot as an attachment on the official Nine Dragons forums in a reply to this thread.

Character Name: (Your character name)
Server Name: (Your server name)
Screenshot of your character in a Summer Costume


Prizes

6 Winners: Splendor Branch (6)
All participants: 500 RC


Rules and Restrictions

Screenshots MUST include your character with their name visible.
The screenshot must be personally taken by you using the in-game screen capture tool and must be submitted in a digital format (ideally PNG/JPG).

Prepare for a bloody Summer! As the Valley of Death grows in its evil power, the time for fun under the Sun has been replaced by bikini-clad fun on the battlefield. In this event, you will be rewarded for your bravery in defeating the evil that lurks in the dungeons of Life and Death!

Life and Death Summer Gift
For the duration of this event, we are giving away exchange tickets for a 30 Day Death Valley Yama Costume to aid you in your defense of the land! Press the H key to access the event window to receive yours today!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/8540e9e5760a5ab0f428164aacb7e93118c208fc.png

Note: The Life and Death Summer Gift can only be received once per account.

Life and Death Vault Festival Buff
Receive the Aura to defeat the Life and Death Vault deviants with the following bonuses, which will run for the duration of the event period.

Increases Maximum Life by 15000
Increases Vital Energy by 15000
Increase  Exp gain by 20%
Increase Life/Vital Energy Absorption by 10/1000

The Life and Death Vault Festival Buff will last for 180 minutes. When the buff expires, you can relog to receive the buff again.

Life and Death Playtime Bonus
Every day, you can receive 3 Life and Death Vault Tickets to enter the Life and Death Dungeon in the Valley of Hell, as well as a Life and Death Coin Bag from the Daily Playtime Bonus. Click on the Stamp Tracker icon under the minimap to view the Playtime Bonus UI.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/585f0cca81d94b938a6e0c9880e544515fa8fa99.png

The boss in the last stage will also drop [Cool Summer] Shark Attack Ticket at a 100% chance. You can produce 1 [Cool Summer] Shark Attack visual variant by combining 12 tickets and 1 [summer] Shark Attack epithet potion.

notes.content:
The race to refinement is on! Everyone, get your tools ready - we're looking for the best handymen out there to attain +18 Glacial/Dark Sapphire Willow Weapon refinement!

The first 3 players on all servers to hit +18 Glacial/Dark Sapphire Willow Weapon refinement (without the use of scrolls) will receive a 2 permanent, as well as a +18 weapon of choice by the end of the event. That's right - you'll have this perk forever!

How to Participate

Talk to Master Refiner Mo Tailan in Hefei to get your refining on!

notes.title: Qingdao 1st Release
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/8e5f4afd6136867578c1edf58f55507814b97a84.png

Qingdao is a village of night, the town of lust and decadence. The village is under the control of the Black Dragon Clan, so the White and Black clan can not easily unleash their momentum.

When dusk falls in the town, the market street becomes sleepless and chaotic due to merchants, thugs, thieves, and gamblers. Rumor has it that the money and treasure collected from the black market and casino are equivalent to Clan of Golden Coins.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/12b00250ef8b34f7e8ffff0e5b3905c322982f66.png

The entrance of Qingdao gateway is located in Hefei near the Strolling Valley. There are several NPCs in front of the gate who can provide various information about Qingdao.

Combat is possible in Qingdao and PvP is encouraged. Low ranks should be aware of the invasions from other players.

White Cloud and Black Cloud Basin
The town is divided into two villages across from a memorial tower called the Ghiryu Tower. Warriors on Black Cloud and White Cloud Basin villages must build up their strength to seize the opposite side.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/4f70b2b384a300505960d1aa42c2a1750523c9e2.png

Qingdao Deviants
Emperor Lei, the ruler of the Black Dragons Clan has gone missing. In his wake, the Black Dragon retainers, The Five Heroes From Darkness have free reign to rule over Qingdao. The Five Heroes from Darkness are composed of Magi, the Black Widows Blood, Kwakil, the Shadowless Sword, Hansung, the Flaming Steel Prince, Pyoje, the Hurrican Sword, and Chaewon, the Double-edge Fangs. The strength of deviant evil forces in Qingdao is no joke! Countless warriors came to challenge the deviants in the name of freedom, but none of them have survived to tell the tale.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/7e25c4641d5000fa1e7c6abdcc11644bc8b0e169.png

Ghiryu Tower
Ghiryu Tower is the symbol of true warlords. Each floor has vicious and fearsome deviants lie in wait. The gate into Ghiryu Tower will be open sometime in the near future.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/665fede115484a4b8d113b48358d779ec3a341ef.png

New Road to Enlightenment and Heroic (Daily) Quests
Talk to Yang Wuqi in Hefei to lead you into your journey to liberating Qingdao from the clutches of the Black Dragons clan and their legion of followers through an assortment of new quests. The villagers need your help and are prepared to reward you handsomely for your efforts!

Create New Items and Increase Your Strength
Gather material items from helping villagers in quests and slaying members of the Black Dragons Clan to create an assortment of new items that will help you recruit Comrades that will aid you in battle, or build Weapons and Armor to give you the strength to stand over your enemies!

notes.title: Comrade System
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/046c54c1b2046d79f181553045ef220663afdecc.png

A Comrade is a companion who will fight on your side especially when you are in critical situations. The Comrade system will provide greater support as the level of your Comrade goes up.

As the level of Comrade goes up, you will gain Inner Chi Points. You can choose 1 option from the list of Yin, Yang, Body, Soul, Life, and Vital Energy to increase the stats.


Attack Attribute: Yin, Yang, Body, or Soul Attack values will be increased.
Resistance Attribute: Yin, Yang, Body, and Soul Resistance values will be increased.
Life Transfer: This will increase your life by transferring a certain amount of Life from your Comrade.
Vital Energy Transfer: Will increase your Vital Energy by transferring a certain amount of Vital Energy from your Comrade.


Recruiting a Comrade
Comrade Recruit system allows you to choose 1 of 6 given Comrades as your companion.
Each of them has a unique story to tell.

You can recruit all 6 but can only have 1 accompany you at a time.

How to Recruit

Select 1 comrade from the portraits located on the left side of the window.
Select the favorite item for the Comrade you’d wish to recruit from your inventory on the right side of the Comrade UI.
Right-click to insert the items into the Recruit Comrade UI and click the Recruit button to hire the selected Comrade.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/8a23721cc8451718935908801a3667f89b5461ef.png

Accompanying with Comrades
The Comrade system allows you to recruit a partner to travel with. When teaming up with a Comrade, they will not only attack together with you but will share vital energy with you in a tough situation.

Your recruited Comrade will automatically be summoned into battle, but can be switched between recruited Comrades by clicking the Accompany button.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/21e5670a22d8bb5c75fb52759549cce8d53f4848.jpg


Comrade Information
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/0afc91fc7b5ff5e0cc5a5835d8b9c96ebbf3512c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/7f07bb6709e9c8b6cba0582ee9def839d3aca1b5.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/5858eff6bb9f4ef5904eb88586897246dd1c4026.png
[/indent]
Comrade Growth
Comrades can level up by gaining Exp. Exp will be gained by feeding them their favorite items. The more favored the item, the more Exp your Comrade will receive.


Click the Growth button located at the bottom of the Comrade menu.
Select and register items that your comrade favors from your inventory.
Click the Use button to gain Exp for your Comrade

Comrade Growth specialized items should be consumed based on your Comrade's current Rank. Comrade Growth Item (M)~(L) is not recommended to be used until Comrade 26 Rank or higher.

Pure Blue Ointment is extremely rare. If you happen to come across one of these items, be sure not to use it until you are at a really high rank.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/83c1fe80133c7eacaebd15a2d77f3c05b66a4572.jpg

There are 2 types of items used to gain Inner Chi Points for your Comrade: Soul Pills (S), Soul Pills (L).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/434e2ddd3c83227b79abbcd6e3a9f9ccd7f979c7.jpg

Comrade Inner Chi Points
You will gain Inner Chi Points upon each Comrade level up. The points can be used to increase the stats of the special skills such as Attributes Attack, Attributes Resistance, Life Transfer, and Vital Energy Transfer.

Click Yin Attack, Yang Attack, Body Attack, Soul Attack, Life Transfer, Vital Energy Transfer, Yin Resistance, Yang Resistance, Body Resistance or Soul Resistance buttons to increase the stats of Comrade that you’ve selected.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/54d69b24a21aff50cd235daebb2b5c127a700460.png
In the case you’ve collected plenty of Inner Chi Points, you can Click the details button and click the + buttons for the Attributes you wish to increase.


Physical/Chi Kung Damage - Attack Damage of your Comrade
Comrades can specialize in either Physical or Chi Kung Damage.
Attack Speed - Attack Speed of the Comrade
Chance of Special Skill Activation - Special Skill chance of the Comrade
Hands of the Inner Destruction - Amount of internal wounds inflicted to opponent
Life Transfer - Max Life increase of the character
Vital Energy Transfer - Max Vital Energy increase of the character
Yin - Yin Attack / Yin Resistance
Yang - Yang Attack / Yang Resistance
Soul - Soul Attack / Soul Resistance
Body - Body Attack / Body Resistance
Inner Chi Point - Amount of Inner Chi Points held and used


Inner Chi Points Reset 
Upon using an item called, 'Oblivion Flower,' all applied Inner Chi Points will reset and able to use again to add their attributes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/f41e3e374f9eb2827f79830f16250b51ed2f6bdf.jpg

White Brandy
Consuming White Brandy will increase the number of attacks as well as increase the chance for your Comrade to cast special skills.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/8fabbb4d0cee726970ef8ce674724d4068af302b.png

Click the White Brandy button on the recruited Comrade window.
White Brandy Refill: While the White Brandy window is active, select White Brandy from your inventory and click the Use button to recharge.
Click the Activate button to activate the item.

White Brandy will be consumed each time your Comrade attacks.

Comrade Achievement
[SIZE=4]Achievement Rank will be determined after surpassing Comrade Lv99 as listed below:
Comrade Lv99 or lower
Defender (Low) -> Comrade Lv100+
Defender (Mid) -> Comrade Lv200+
Defender (High) -> Comrade Lv300+
Entry Guard -> Comrade Lv400+
Official Guard -> Comrade Lv500+
The Defense Unit (Low) -> Comrade Lv600+
The Defense Unit (Mid) -> Comrade Lv700+
The Master Guard -> Comrade Lv900+[/size]

notes.title: Update: Hainan Island
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/46175e37537a4620d4a4ebb870ac332f13380349.png

Swords of the Dragon Warlord - The Book of White Dragon Spirits
For the past few decades, a great number of skilled warriors have been in search of 2 legendary artifacts called, Nine Dragon Jade Circle and Swords of the Dragon Warlords, scouring the land, whenever a clue presents itself.

During their never-ending journey, many warriors from various clans have learned and improved their kung-fu skills exponentially by defeating evil deviants and members of the rival clans in their way.

The legend of the Swords of The Dragon Warlords is proven by renowned archaeologists over numerous years showing evidence that this artifact is more than just a myth.

The legendary Nine Dragon Jade Circle was an accessory, which belonged to the Thunder Emperor, a great legendary warrior. He carved his ultimate kung-fu techniques on the surface of a circle accessory and scattered it's 9 pieces before heading out to the final battle of the War of Nine Dragons.

On the other hand, the tale of the Swords of the Dragon Warlords tells of how the swords were magically forged using 5 sacred elements, and the spirits of 5 Dragons sealed within. According to legend, those who acquire all 5 swords shall unlock the secret passage of the Treasure of the Dragon Warlord, which is has been said to be the key to achieve the status of Overlord of the Mighty Dragons.

The Thunder Emperor had the chance to gain the Black Dragon Warlord Sword, one of the 5 legendary swords, and has achieved Super Metamorphosis, leaving a bloodbath in his wake.

After countless years of searching, a secret room has been discovered in Potala Palace, during their most recent clan battle. What was so important in about the tiny room, that it had been sealed for decades? Even the elders and high councils of the palace had no idea of its existence. Within the dusty room lay nothing, but an old bookshelf containing the legendary Book of White Dragon Spirits. This was one of the greatest discoveries of the century, proving the story of the Swords of the Dragon Warlords was more than just an ancient myth.

Without hesitation, the leaders of well-established clans rushed to Potala Palace in Tibet, in order to conduct an expedition to unlock and obtain the secrets of the Book of White Dragon Spirits. Countless souls perished during their investigation, but nothing could stop them from acquiring the precious book, as they paved the roads to Potala Palace with blood.

The strongest 6 clans were no exception but realized that the battle over the legendary artifacts must be halted before any further expeditions could be conducted. Ultimately, the leaders of the 6 clans had an official meeting and came to an agreement to forge 6 copies of the Book of White Dragon Spirits, to be passed down to the successors of each clan head, putting an end to the surrounding chaos.

After the forgeries of the Book of White Dragon Spirits were handed to the leader of each clan, leading scholars and archaeologists are gathered to decode the ancient text and reveal the path to become the Overlord of the Mighty Dragons.

The decoding process was a very tedious and complicated process, uncovering the meaning of only 3 sentences thus far:

Crimson Fog
"Everywhere is filled with blood, smoke, fog, and corpses..."

Scattering Souls
"Difficult to perform techniques by scattering one's vital energy."

Silent Fortress
"There is no safe zone due to the surrounding delicate formations."

Hainan Location
Hainan Island is located on the southern edge of China.
You can move only if you have an item called Hainan Teleport Scroll, which will teleport you to a random spot on the island.
You can acquire the scroll from the Hainan Survivor, Masked Man in Hefei.
The only way to leave the island is to ride on a boat at the shoreline to Liaodong. However, please notice that once you leave, you will have to use another Hainan Teleport Scroll to return.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/87331ac3ea592a663d1aaa67cbc440f643465c95.jpg

Character Restrictions in Hainan

No Parties or Raid Parties
Unable to move while in Penalty Status
Unable to move to other areas while in dungeon
Unable to move by using any type of Summon abilities
Unable to move while in battle


Hainan Function
No Allies on the Island. Kill or be Killed.

No chat function is allowed except whisper.
Excluding Kung-Fu Skills, all other features, including weapons, clothes, accessories, and graphical effects will be disabled.
There will only be 2 types of character appearance based on their gender. (as shown in the image below)
The names of other characters on the island will appear as masked to hide their identities.
No Party, Master & Disciple, Hero Band, or Hero League is allowed. Remember, it is kill or be killed.
PvP results on the island will not be affected on your Combat record.
You cannot select to see the info of other characters.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/89f7437d4ae50bbe9d0007f30b61b17767725644.png

Mighty Traps and Secret Formation of the Hainan Island

3 unbreakable formation traps are set on the island causing various debuffs.
The effect of the traps is set everywhere on the island.
Click "Hainan Island" on the world map to see further details.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/87331ac3ea592a663d1aaa67cbc440f643465c95.jpg

Unable to verify location while on Hainan Island

Due to impending traps, all indicators including Mini-map and other Axis features are disabled on the island.
Wanted Status and Location Tracking are disabled on the island.
Huatuo's Panacea will revive the character in a random spot on the island.


Ironblood Points

Ironblood Points can be acquired via PvE and Quests on the island. (PvP gains are disabled on our version to prevent Ironblood Points abuse)
A certain amount of Ironblood Points will be deducted if the character dies.
Ironblood Points can be used to purchase various items from the Ironblood Point Merchant hidden on the island.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/888cf7a87973495e1f24dd15eddda732ed34f404.jpg

Halloween is just around the corner, and that means it's pumpkin carving season in the States! Unleash your carving tools and other creative cutlery to carve up a Halloween-themed jack-o-lantern.

Submission Date: October 21, 2019 - November 4, 2019
Winners Announcement: November 8, 2019

How to Enter
Carve your choice of pumpkin, squash, fruits, or melon.
Snap a photo with a hand-written postcard displaying your character name and www.playredfox.com/nine_dragons.
Then click the UPLOAD A FILE button below to submit your entry.

Submission Tips:

Try to take the best picture possible, as picture quality helps make a good impression on the judges.
Get the lighting right. Some jack-o-lanterns will look best lit up at night. Others call for a dramatically cloudy daytime sky or even full sunshine. Experiment to see what looks best for you.
Pay close attention to the background of your carving.
You can have a look at past winners here.

Trace of Guardian
Search through dungeons for signs of the guardians who seek you! For the duration of the event, gather as many Trace of Guardian as possible by defeating mobs over level 150 in the following dungeons.

Purple Dungeon: The School of Rising Sun, Icy Dungeon, Black Temple, and Potala Fortress.

Hello, Dragons,

The servers will undergo maintenance and server update on Tuesday (02/12) starting at 18:00 server time. The downtime will be approximately 4 hours.

Reason:

Storm vs. Storm update

Thank you for your patience during the maintenance.

===============

Patch Notes 159 for February 12, 2019
The following release notes contain information about the update.

Storm vs. Storm Update
Storm vs. Storm (SvS) is a power struggle between Hero Bands that occur every week, where players attempt to capture Stone Pillars to gain rewards.

The first battle will begin on Saturday, February 16, 2019, at 9:00 AM PST.

Starting Storm vs. Storm

Locate the Storm vs. Storm menu by accessing the SvS tab of the F11 menu.
Storm vs. Storm will only be held at the Fortress of Majesty in Hangzhou.
Only the Band Master can request and cancel the SvS Challenge. Up to 50 Hero Bands can participate per one SvS.
SvS Registration Period: Between the end of the previous battle and one week before the next one begins. (Unable to register once the SvS has already started.)
The "Waiting Area" button will automatically appear 30 minutes before the start of the upcoming Storm vs. Storm. "Waiting Area" button can be found in the F11menu → Storm vs. Storm tab. Click the button to move to the Fortress waiting area. The function is available until the end of Storm vs. Storm.
Health Potions, Huatuo Panacea, and Lightfoot are prohibited during the battle. Recovery skills, continuous recovery potions, and Siphon Panacea can be used.
There is no death or combat penalty, and you are allowed to attack members from the same clan.

Storm vs. Storm Progress

At the beginning of Storm vs. Storm, all Stone Pillars located in the Fortress are uncaptured and ready to occupied. A total of 10 Stone Pillars protected by Fortress Guard DNPCs
Deviants will appear a total of 10 times to protect each Stone Pillar.  As time goes by, more powerful deviants will emerge, so it is recommended to defeat them.
Characters who died during Storm vs. Storm can revive back to the waiting area with Impervious time effect of 30 seconds. The Impervious time effect is reduced when you use the Pillar to teleport.

Storm vs. Storm Rewards

The Hero Band with the most amount of Stone Pillar occupied will be declared as Lord of the Fortress and will receive trade/sell taxes on all items in Zhengzhou, Shi Zhang, Jinan, Datong, Nanchang, Tibet, Hangzhou, Liaodong, Hefei, The Cave of the Conqueror, Loulan, North Sea, and Kunlun.
The tax rate gain is base on how many Stone Pillar captured. (1 Stone Pillar = 10% Tax Rate)
The tax rate accumulation will begin from the time of the end of SvS and can only be withdrawn by the Hero Band Master.

Ended Lunar New Year Event

Removed 2019 letters from dungeon drops.
Removed Lunar New Year content from the Festival Merchant, Seo Hwarang NPC resource and trade list.
The Golden Pig Summoning Spirit sale has ended.
*]Removed winter themed decoration in Hefei Marketplace.

Black vs. White War
Black vs. White war schedule has changed. The new schedule is every Thursday at 20:00 and Sunday at 11:00 server time.

Bug Fixes

Fixed an exploit where the same type relic can be equipped simultaneously.
Fixed an issue where skills cannot be used after being revived by a party member.
Fixed an issue where skills can gain experience points while attacking stands.
Fixed a bug where the healer formation skill cooldown can be canceled.
Fixed the description of Blood Mushroom skill on Blood Sorcerer Crimson weapons.
Abnormal transition progress through data exchange during client execution is corrected.

Improvements

Improved the Character (C) window where it closes while character bag is open.
Stats tooltip between Character (C) window and Character summary window is now the same.

Miscellaneous

The Hero Band and Master & Disciple list have been reset.
Infinite Dungeon ranking have been reset, and points distributed to the top 50.

notes.title: New Event Server: Yang Opens Aug 22!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/685e04a56c4f90b947eab63591573ceb453602ca.png

Dear Dragons,

We are pleased to announce that 9Dragons will be launching our first event server on August 21, 2018! This is a perfect opportunity for players who want a fresh start or to play on equal footing from the very beginning of the adventure. Mark your calendars and keep an eye on our announcement, as we will keep you all updated with additional details closer to the launch date.

Launch Date:
August 21, 2018 after server maintenance

Server Rates:
3x Exp, 4x Skill, 4x Drop

The new event server Yang will be merged into Yin server at the end of Season 1. All players participating in the new server must either have an account or create a NEW RedFox Games account with no characters on Tao or Yin server to qualify for a server merge after the event.

=====

New Event Server FAQ
Please review the important FAQ below.

What is an Event server?
Event server is a booster server that is brought online designed to give players a clean slate to play on equal footing from the very beginning of the adventurer.

What is the name of the new Event server?
The new Event server will be named Yang.

When does the Event server launch?
The server officially opens on August 21, 2018.

Will I be able to transfer my existing characters on this Event server?
No – any existing character will be unable to transfer to the event server.

Can I use my prior account to access this server?
Yes – you can use your existing account to access the Event server. However, to qualify for the transfer at the end of Season 1, you must have no characters on both Yin and Tao server.

What is the name of the server my character will be transfer to at the end of Season 1?
At the end of Season 1, all characters from the Event server will be transfer into Yin server.

What will not be transferred and be reset at the end of Season 1?
The following information will be initialized and will not be transferred:

Hero Band
Friend List
Master & Disciple
Carrier Pigeon Inbox
Loulan PvP Record
Combat Record
Server Ranking Data
Black vs. White War
Duel PvP Record
Hero Tournament
SvS
Loyalty
Items and gold stored in the Warehouse/Quest Storage will NOT be transferred.
Items stored in the Purchase Inventory(Cart, Gift, and Cart (Web) will NOT be transferred.
Items and gold stored in the Auction House will NOT be transferred.


Will the RedFox Games Marketplace be any different in the Event server? 
No. The Marketplace will have the same items as Yin and Tao server.

notes.content:

In battle, martial artists carry their weapons as extensions of their own warrior spirit. In some cases, these weapons gain fame, honor, and notoriety, often giving them names. This is a creative event, where players will display their weapons, and tell us about their weapon’s name and the reason behind it.

HOW TO ENTER:

Take a screenshot with your character and a weapon of choice. (Be sure to press F5 to hide the UI.)
Post your screenshot in this forum thread.	 

Give your weapon a unique name.
Explain why you have given your weapon that name.
Extra points for details and a creative back story.


Example:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/14d6bf532b528457cdf0f1551ac897a2b7b2336a.jpg

Server: Yin

notes.title: Contest: Video Guide Specialist
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/dae0a0afb09c22915c71d0f43c5fde308365d8d6.png

Do you like to make video guides for games? Take this opportunity to get rewarded for your work by creating a Nine Dragons Awaken video guide, and submitting your video in our Video Guide Specialist Contest!

Although the video guide subject is entirely up to you, here are some subjects we are looking for:

Any of our updates, or renewals
Beginner to advanced leveling
Beginner to advanced farming
Dungeons
Class and Role specific
Crafting
Refinement
Questline
etc.


HOW TO ENTER:

Create a video guide of your choice and upload it to Youtube.com.
Post a link of your video in response to this thread. 
Please read the contest rules for more information


PRIZES:

1st - 15,000 RedFox Credits (1 winner)
2nd - 7,500 RedFox Credits (2 winners)
3rd - 5,000 RedFox Credits (2 winners)


RULES:

Contest begins March 16th, 2018, and ends at 6PM PDT on April 6th, 2018
Prizes will be awarded to the account the entry is posted on.
All videos must be uploaded to YouTube and listed as Public.
After uploading your video to YouTube, post the link in this thread.
All video titles must have the following format: [9Dragons Awaken] Video Guide Specialist + “Subject of your guide”
The video description must contain:

Your forum name
Short description of your guide
The game’s website: https://www.playredfox.com/nine_dragons

Video must include both RedFox Games and Nine Dragons Awaken logos which can be found in the Video Guide Specialist  forum page.
The contest winners must provide raw assets and final cut video to be eligible to receive rewards.
The style of the video is open (e.g. animation, text-based, image-based, facecam-based, mixed, etc.)
Special effects may be used, but should not overshadow the video’s content.
You may use in the video, any information available to the Nine Dragons Awaken community (e.g. Website, Forums, etc.)
Your video must not include any copyrighted music or content.
Post must include the in-game character name chosen for the contest.
Prizes will be granted as-is; no substitutions will be offered.
Winners will be selected under the following criteria:

Video Quality
Helpfulness
Regardless of the amount of participating users, if none of the video entries meet our standards in terms of video quality or helpfulness, no winners will be selected.

All contest decisions are at the discretion of Red Fox Games and are final.


*To be considered eligible to win prizes, all rules must be followed. By breaking any of the rules, you'll be disqualified from the event.

notes.title: Event: 2nd Year Anniversary Celebration
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/ad6ed41bbb1aec9d799c0164eb07026348451627.png

Can you believe it? Nine Dragons Awaken has been officially online for 2 years! We would like to extend our gratitude for joining us on this journey. We will continue to strive to bring the best gaming experience to all for many more years to come. Let’s all celebrate this momentous occasion with the 2nd Year Anniversary Event!

2nd Year Anniversary Playtime Bonus
Each day you log in, make sure to click your “Stamp Tracker” icon located below the mini-map in the game to receive your reward(s). The longer you stayed logged in, the more rewards you receive! Log in for the below cumulative periods of time over the event periods to receive Golden Pig!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/0cae6693ebef07f1da33383af94b3501f612416a.png


Click the “Stamp Tracker” icon located below the mini-map in the game to display the Accumulated Event.

You must achieve a cumulative amount of minutes/hours over the event period logged in to receive the event prizes.
The prizes are cumulative. If you qualified for a higher tier of Playtime rewards, you would also receive all lower tiers.
Prizes are limited to once per account.


Find the Golden Pig
Golden Pigs have been added to The Land. Once you find a Golden Pig, kill it to obtain Gold Pig for a Golden Egg!

Golden Pigs will appear in the field maps excluding Clan Base, Bamboo Village, Hefei, and Kunlun.
Golden Pigs will drop either Lucky Golden Coins and/or Gold Pig.
Obtain more Gold Pigs by hunting Golden Pigs in Loulan.
Golden Pigs replaces Lucky Golden Boxes for the duration of the event

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/8131d70cab60138f8e21fbbaedcec23a105841bd.png

Golden Egg contains one of the following items:

Flamed Soul Box
Frozen Soul Box
Golden Coin Piece
Gold Pig
Ancient Golden Compass
Ancient Silver Compass
Flag of Chaos
Rising Bead of Kylin
Golden 9Dragons Box

1,000,000
5,000,000
10,000,000
25,000,000
50,000,000


So what are you waiting for? Jump in today and earn some of these awesome prizes as we celebrate our 2nd year of Nine Dragons!

2nd Year Anniversary OX Quiz
OX Quiz will begin every Saturday during the event period. Visit the Dragon's Cave (OX Quiz Zone) to start your path to the upcoming quiz battle! Please refer to the OX Quiz Introduction post here.

Event Schedule: 

3/10 Saturday at 8:00
3/17 Saturday at 19:00
3/24 Saturday at 8:00
3/31 Saturday at 19:00

We encourage everyone to participate in the OX Quiz event. Even if you don't win, you'll still get a reward for participating! Join in all four OX Quiz battle to receive four different colors "Quiz Battle Token", which can be traded in for ten "Golden Egg".

Four lucky winners will receive either a Demon-faced Soul Plate, Demon-faced Risen Plate, God of Wind, or a God of Rain.
Receive one Golden Egg, three Special Sweet Cake, and five Huato's Pancea when you answer all questions correctly.
Receive three Special Sweet Bread and two Experience Bonus Card when you answer more than eight questions correctly.
Receive three Special Sweet Cake and Quiz Battle Token when you participate!
Receive Glory of the Clan Buff (Attributes increased by 25, Movement Speed doubled, attack rate increased by 500 for 30 mins) when the event ends.


Marketplace Item: Golden Pig
From now until 6:00 PM, April 3rd, you'll be able to also purchase the Golden Egg from our Marketplace!

Golden Egg (15+4) + Exchanged Coupon Epithet(30 Days)
Golden (5+1)
Golden Egg (1)

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/fdafbfb0a82814c73455ca120433a0fa0cb12414.png

Notes:

The event schedule and details are subject to change without notice or compensation
Click the [?] icon located at the top-right corner to open up the Resource and Create window.
Hoover over the magnifying glass to check the properties of the item.
Reward items are obtained at a fixed probability -- there is no guarantee that you will obtain them.
Golden Pig Event will end on March 27th's maintenance.
Event items and Resource list will be deleted from the game. Be certain to use/open them by [strike]April 3rd's[/strike] (TBA) maintenance.

notes.title: Valentine's Day Event, with Bonuses!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/458751a139f6b4090d0d2eb326c31f3ac5fd5fea.png

Love is in the air as we celebrate Valentine's Day event! In honor of Valentine's Day and Lunar New Year, we're activating the following bonuses which will run for the duration of the event.

All attributes increases by 30
Item drop increases by 200% (3x)
Experience gain increases by 100% (2x)
Movement speed increases by 30%
Weapon attack increases by 25%

The Valentine's Day buff will last for 120 minutes. When the buff expires; you can relog to receive the buff again.

Good couples put in the time to make things work, and the Nine Dragons team is here to reward you for your persistence. Log in for the below cumulative periods of time over the event periods to receive Valentine’s Day Chocolate!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/e229c4c55eba69e7c37bdb3cb7fdaf625b501294.png

Note:

Click the “Stamp Tracker” icon located below the minimap in the game to display the Accumulated Event.
You must achieve a cumulative amount of minutes/hours over the event period logged in to receive the event prizes.
The prizes are cumulative. If you qualified for a higher tier of Playtime rewards, you would also receive all lower tiers.
Prizes are limited to once per account.
The event schedule and details are subject to change.
Click the [?] icon located at the top-right corner to open up the Resource and Create window.
Hoover over the magnifying glass to check the properties of the item.


This event will run from Tuesday, February 14th, through Tuesday, February 27th 18:00 PDT.
